reviews.title: God’s word
reviews.text:
I am thankful for being able to read scripture in so many different translations. However, I don’t like that you want me to PAY if I want to use a reading plan or read parallel. Many of your users do not have the funds to be able to pay for services. 
Also, you track information on me. That should not be done.

reviews.title: Other versions? Not available??
reviews.text: For years, I used the app on my tablet for fast look-ups.  Comparing what is said in different versions.  But I cannot even find any other versions.  It’s stuck in NJKV, my preference, but where’s the rest of the versions?

reviews.title: Major step backwards
reviews.text: While the website is still usable, this app is not designed for serious study, the the app support is a joke. Resources used to be paired with verses, now even for legacy Bible Gateway Plus members the resources don’t show.  Emails to support are responded to, but it is as though they do not understand the issues.  My last support request was responded to with a  how-to list of how to navigate the app, yet the problem is that the app is not responding.  The only thing that seems to work is nagware to join Bible Gateway Plus with a 7 day trial - despite being a Bible Gateway Plus member that is logged in ( and my payment receipts show clear back to 2018 in the app so it must know who I am.) This is no longer the valuable study tool it once was.

reviews.title: Plus is buggy
reviews.text: Unable to get plus version to work. Set up the free trial, confirmation from Apple Store, but app continually locks up and gives pop ups to try the plus version. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Poor functioning
reviews.text: Under resources you can not scroll up and view all.  This app has always been buggy which is too bad because it offers a lot of great content

reviews.title: Bible Gateway:
reviews.text: I’m totally blind and not able to select a different Bible versions I’d like to use. It’s not user friendly. Can you please fix this? And is there where you can hide the verses if you wanted to? Thanks!

reviews.title: Ads impede use
reviews.text: This used to be a good app. But over the past years, so the ads have become so pervasive that it’s almost impossible to use. At least 50% of the time you click on anything to try to get a passage, you get a very long ad. So it’s virtually unusable. If the mission is to get the word of God out, something needs to change. It’s truly unusable as is. I will be looking for another app.

reviews.title: What have you done to this app?
reviews.text: This used to be the best Bible app anywhere. So many translations available. Easy to use.  But I just spent 5 minutes trying to get the app to show me the book of James. It won’t do it. It will show me ads. It will not show me the Bible.

reviews.title: Complete garbage app
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years, and it never used to have ads but now I can’t even get past the ads to actually read the Bible. Just deleted this one and downloaded a free ad-free Bible app.

reviews.title: Too many ads
reviews.text: The app content is great but the functionality  is frustrating.  It's difficult to close ads or they take too long. It feels manipulative.

reviews.title: Unusable—cluttered with ads
reviews.text:
This app used to be halfway decent, but it is now so cluttered with ads that it’s completely unusable. 

The last straw for me is that somehow the default translation when I try to look anything up is in Italian. I didn’t select that. I’m sure I could change it back but why bother. Anything would be better than this.

reviews.title: App is broken, doesn’t go to search result when clicked
reviews.text:
It literally chooses somewhere else and drops you off when selecting a verse from search. The only thing this app had going for it was its robust searching options at one point. Now it can’t even do that, but it CAN give you ads and personal data tracking for your troubles.
Find somewhere else.

reviews.text: I used to use the search feature on the app for keywords and now it doesn’t even work properly anymore it pulls up the verses but then when you select the verse it either takes you to a completely different part of the Bible or back to the Home Screen like it crashes out of search. A huge disappointment

reviews.title: Not so much for the app itself as the website ad filtering
reviews.text:
This morning, I opened the website to find a scripture in another translation.

Multiple ads popped up containing photos of a nearly naked woman for a lingerie company.

There are ways to filter ads. You either don’t care enough to be intentional about that, or you’re not well enough informed. I highly doubt the latter consider how well known and big this website / platform is.

I’m not offended by seeing the female form, but I’m disappointed at the thought that this could be something a brother in Christ, a young child, or someone else struggling may see.

Please do a better job of filtering what companies come through on your the websites ads, or don’t have pop up ads at all.

reviews.title: No.  No. No. This app has lost all value.
reviews.text:
Whatever the update in the summer of 2022, this app has become worthless. Constantly dropping out, unable to stay open, losing track of scripture. I’ve complained and complained, but no one is listening. Prior to the recent update, I loved the app. Have notes for the past 10 years that I will lose - that’s just how bad the app has become.

UPDATE 3/2024

It’s unbelievable that the update that ruined this app can’t be reversed.  I’ve been in touch with admin (Kyle), but the issues have morphed into other issues.  As I look back, it’s been over 5 years since problems came with some ‘update’.

5 YEARS!!  How in the world can anything be so bad that after 5 years it’s worse than it ever was?

I’m still trying to use the app, as there is no alternative to it.  Besides, I have notes that go back to 2012, and I can still access them while reading the scripture in another app.

UPDATE 6/1/26
14 Years of taking careful sermon and study notes, they are completely 100% gone.  I tried reaching out for administrative help 2 months ago - no reply.

So I have deleted the program from all my devices.  I will never recover from the loss of so much information, shared with my children and grandchildren as they struggled with Christianity vs the world. Documented prayers and discussions, all gone.

Also, the audio skips back-and-forth, especially at the completion of the book.

It’s very difficult to navigate and will not switch to different verses easily. It wants to stay on the same verses and if you copy to paste, it will take all your previous clipboard copies and paste them too! Not user-friendly, looking for another app… not to mention, they added commercials that are a pain, you have to wait to exit out of each one of them. Not good!

reviews.title: Meh...
reviews.text: The old version of the app was better. It wasn't pretty on the eyes but it had downright solid function. This new version feels like the "Harbor Freight Version" or "Aldi Version" of an app that got a lot more attention given to it. This new iteration is to too laggy, too janky. It feels like a cheap off the shelf app. Getting around to different verses and chapters is too time consuming. And the yearly price went up to $70. It's not worth anywhere near $70. The $40 I have been paying (including a $10 discount) was already a stretch for what you get with this app. I will not be renewing.

reviews.title: Used to be my favorite app
reviews.text: The new update messed with the audio feature and it’s terrible. Not sure if the android/samsung app is better or not, but for iPhones I’m very disappointed. When you play the audio, you used to be able to control it from the “now playing” feature in the control panel, Lock Screen, notification screen, etc. but with this new update that no longer works. This feature being broken has a pretty big impact. Since it cannot be controlled using the “now playing” feature, the functionality is extremely limited. I used to be able to start playing a scripture and go about doing housework and the like, and be able to pause or rewind as necessary in a convenient way, even pausing from my AirPods which was very helpful. I also used to be able to set timers for it to stop playing after a while so I could go to sleep listening to God’s Word, it was wonderful. However, since it no longer works with the “now playing” feature, this too no longer works. I also tried using the timer built within the audio feature but that also doesn’t work. I must admit I have absolutely no idea what purpose the built in timer serves. I keep setting it thinking it will do something but no, once the timer runs out it simply doesn’t say “timer” and count down anymore, no tone to alert you the timer is done, doesn’t stop playing, nothing. It took some testing to figure out what exactly was happening. After trial and error, I found that this timer only works to stop the readings if your screen is unlocked and the au

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: This was a great app before they took away all its features and functionality. Used to be able to mark passages as favorites with a star. No longer. And the passages I marked now have stars I can’t get rid of. Used to be able to limit searches to certain books. No longer. This app is less useful after the update than it was before the update. Before the update I used it every day to read the Bible. It now sits useless on my virtual shelf. I understand the need for ads, so when they added those, I didn’t mind, even though I don’t like them. I now hate the app and will soon delete it. I’m only waiting to see if the problems are going to be fixed. I keep thinking that I must be wrong, and I just can’t find how to do what I used to be able to do. I’m quickly abandoning  that idea. Bible Gateway used to be great. Used to be.
